verdict.rationale: Gitea documents the building blocks: pull-request and AGit code review, Gitea Actions CI/CD workflows, permission and access-control management, and API/webhooks for custom workflows. However, the evidence never shows that approvals or passing checks can be enforced as a mandatory gate before merge or deploy, so the 'require' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: branch protection with required approvals, required status checks blocking merge, deployment environment approval gates, independent hands-on corroboration of enforced approval workflows.
